correctness.rationale: The cyclic triple cover has exactly twelve resolved cubic cones away from the smooth preimage of a transverse conic. Its 18 branch points are the exact base locus of the four-section birational map; after their blowup the only divisor contracted to the vertex is the smooth genus-16 preimage D, with D^2=12-18=-6 and N_D=ρ*O(-2). Finite Euler stratification gives e(S)=70; smoothing a degree-nine surface with twelve homogeneous cubic isolated singularities gives μ(vertex)=459-70-12*8=293. The exact standalone checker verifies a characteristic-zero-open conic witness, incidence, and all arithmetic; geometry is proved independently of finite enumeration.

value.rationale: The motivating recent nonic realizes a self-product of elliptic curves as a normal hypersurface, and prior work computed the singularity basket but left the high-multiplicity vertex resolution undetermined. A single smooth genus-16 exceptional curve with normal bundle ρ*O(-2) gives a precise new minimal-resolution graph, while μ=293 quantifies its smoothing topology. These natural invariants may inform the exceptional singularity geometry without claiming a broad classification. The prior singularity basket is not repackaged as a new contribution.
